text.description_html:
Don-Jo CLP-110-630, Outswing Commercial Door Stainless Security Plate

This stainless steel security door latch protector is 10" high and designed specifically for commercial type outswing doors (door opens out of the room or building). For use with Mortise Locks or key-in knobs / levers (door knobs or levers that use a key to unlock).

Protect your commercial entry doors from tampering and latch prying with this stainless steel security latch protector plate. No special tools required for installation.

Also available: 6" Commercial Door Latch Guard.

The mounting studs are concealed welded to the back side of the security plate leaving no visible point of attack from the outside. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Non-Handed, reversible for left or right hand outswinging doors.

Specifications for the Don-Jo CLP-110-630 Security Latch Guard:

  • Plate Height: 10"
  • Plate Width: 2-1/8"
  • Plate Thickness: 12 Gauge (.104")
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Offset: 1/4" (.250")
  • Non-Handed (reversible)
  • Fasteners: 2 each 1/4-20 x 1-3/4" flat head machine screws and finishing washers.
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Don-Jo CLP-110-630 Security Plate Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually.
